defect_classes.name: preflight-env-no-repair
defect_classes.root_cause: Worktree provisioning does not materialize declared env prerequisites (local.properties sdk.dir) and launch preflight has no auto-repair verb — a known, deterministic fix waits on a human decision round-trip per lane.

defect_classes.name: baseline-gate-wedge
defect_classes.root_cause: A required gate failing on out-of-write_paths baseline drift has no recorded waiver path: crew-answer decisions are advisory chat text, not gate-ledger receipts, so every downstream lane re-asks the same question and done keeps refusing.

defect_classes.name: unmapped-stall-loop
defect_classes.root_cause: Stall/budget/replan error classes surface to the boss as 'unmapped class' with retry/drop/replan alternates that don't incorporate the lane's own diagnostic (which gate failed, why) — same-brief relaunches repeat the identical failure until attempt budget is exhausted.

defect_classes.name: dispatch-retry-no-backoff
defect_classes.root_cause: The drive loop retries launch verbs verbatim across saturation, stale-attempt, and terminal-cancel refusals instead of classifying the refusal (capacity → backoff-and-requeue; stale attempt → resolve current attempt; cancelled → scope-drop route).

defect_classes.name: foreign-write-attribution
defect_classes.root_cause: Foreign-write counter records raw seqs without classifying writer role vs declared write_paths, producing an 810-entry noise blob that flips process verdict to fail with no actionable membership.

solution_classes.name: preflight-materialize-repair
solution_classes.mechanism: Extend launch preflight with a `repairs` step for declared env prerequisites: when a gate profile names `local.properties:sdk.dir`, copy/derive it from the host's canonical Android config (or the lease-holder checkout) into the lane worktree before refusing, and record the repair in preflight.json — refusal only when no source exists.

solution_classes.name: gate-waiver-receipt
solution_classes.mechanism: A granted crew-answer that accepts a failing gate writes a `waiver` row into the lane's gate ledger (gate_id, FAIL receipt ref, out-of-scope test list, decision id). `done` accepts FAIL+waiver; relaunch/replan decisions read the ledger instead of re-asking, and identical-signature stalls auto-map to 'replan-required' when the same gate fails twice on out-of-scope tests.

solution_classes.name: refusal-classified-dispatch
solution_classes.mechanism: Classify launch-verb stderr into refusal classes (saturation, stale-attempt, cancelled-lane, env-missing) in the drive loop: saturation enqueues with backoff; stale-attempt re-reads lane.attempts and retries once; cancelled routes to scope-drop decision instead of relaunch. Cap verbatim retries at 1.

solution_classes.name: foreign-write-triage
solution_classes.mechanism: Attribute each foreign-write seq to actor role + path vs lane write_paths at record time; report verdict counts only true out-of-scope source writes, with bookkeeping/coordinator writes folded into a separate non-failing counter.

proposals.title: Preflight env materialization: auto-repair declared prerequisites (local.properties sdk.dir) in lane worktrees
proposals.why: Four lanes (s2-features, ver-s2, IMPROVER, SUMMARY) were refused at launch preflight on the same missing file; each cost a boss decision + relaunch. The fix is deterministic — preflight.json already names the missing prerequisite, and the host checkout carries a known-good local.properties.
proposals.change: In crew launch preflight (src/crew/, the launch-preflight/v1 checker), add a `repairs` hook: for each declared env prerequisite that has a deterministic source (sdk.dir from the bound checkout's local.properties or $ANDROID_HOME), write it into the lane worktree and record `repaired` in the preflight row. Refuse only when no source resolves. Skip for read-only lanes (IMPROVER/SUMMARY shouldn't need it — or mark those lanes' gate profiles env-free).
acceptance: launch-preflight/v1 row shows repaired='local.properties:sdk.dir' instead of ok=false when the file is absent but a source exists
a fresh lane worktree launches without a crew-answer round-trip for missing sdk.dir
read-only lanes (improver/summary class) pass preflight without materializing sdk.dir
new unit test: preflight repairs missing sdk.dir from bound checkout; refusal preserved when no source exists

proposals.title: Gate waiver receipt: turn granted baseline-drift decisions into durable gate-ledger entries
proposals.why: The same 6 upstream-drift test failures were litigated four separate times (ask-eb49f98cc3, ask-ff8b514242, ask-85608f8e72, ask-9b81197e3c) across two lanes because the waiver lives in chat, not the gate ledger. a-ticket's 9-attempt spiral traces directly to done refusing a gate whose failure was already ruled acceptable.
proposals.change: Add a `waiver` artifact under lanes/<id>/receipts/ written when a crew-answer grants a gate waiver: {gate_id, receipt_ref, out_of_scope_tests[], decision_id, expires_on_head_change}. Teach `done`/stamp-result to accept a FAIL receipt paired with a valid waiver for tests outside write_paths, and teach the relaunch/stall mapper to read waivers so identical-signature stalls stop re-escalating.
acceptance: a lane with a FAIL g1-unit-suite receipt limited to out-of-write_paths tests stamps done when a waiver row exists
a second stall on the same gate signature auto-maps to the recorded waiver, not a fresh boss ask
waiver invalidated (re-ask required) when the lane head changes under it
done accepts FAIL+waiver for out-of-scope failures; waiver reuse on identical stall signature

proposals.title: Classified dispatch refusals: backoff on saturation, resolve stale attempts, route cancelled lanes to scope-drop
proposals.why: crew-error:26/27/28/35/36 show the drive loop re-issuing identical launch verbs against terminal refusals — three verbatim retries on stale-attempt, relaunch of a cancelled lane, and a step-cap burn. Each refusal class already carries a parseable reason in the CrewError message.
proposals.change: In the drive/launch wrapper, parse CrewError refusal reasons into classes: `saturation` → mark lane blocked-by-capacity and requeue on next sweep; `stale-attempt` → refresh attempts and retry once; `cancelled` → never relaunch, emit a scope-drop decision row; `env-missing` → handled by P1. Cap identical retries at 1 per sweep.
acceptance: host-pressure refusal parks the lane rather than erroring the drive chain
stale-attempt launch re-reads attempt count before retrying (no triple-repeat)
cancelled-lane launch produces a scope-drop decision, not a LaunchError
unit test per refusal class asserting the mapped recovery action

proposals.title: Foreign-write attribution: classify writers at record time so process verdict counts only real fence violations
proposals.why: 810 foreign_write_seqs flipped verdict.process to fail with no actionable list — most seqs are coordinator/engine bookkeeping writes, not lane fence violations. A run-ending 'fail' that mostly measures bookkeeping is noise that hides real violations.
proposals.change: Record actor role and target path with each foreign-write seq; at report time split into `bookkeeping` (coordinator/run-state writes — non-failing) and `violations` (lane writes outside write_paths — failing). Verdict counts only violations; report lists violation paths per lane.
acceptance: run-report writers block separates bookkeeping vs violation counts
a run with only coordinator bookkeeping writes does not fail the process verdict
a true out-of-write_paths lane write still fails process and names lane+path
verdict regression test: bookkeeping-only foreign writes → process pass

proposals.title: Lease-liveness reconciliation at lane launch and done
proposals.why: a-ticket hit 'no lease' blocks three times (observations #10/#14/#18) and IMPROVER's own launch refused on a live-lease check (crew-error:36) — lease presence and pane liveness diverge on crash/salvage paths, and each wedge costs a manual repair cycle.
proposals.change: At lane launch and at done, reconcile the lease file against the pane's live session: missing lease + live session → re-mint and log; stale lease + dead session → clear and log. Fold the check into the existing lease-check.json artifact so refusals name the divergent field.
acceptance: launch proceeds when lease is absent but the owning session is alive (lease re-minted, logged)
launch proceeds when lease names a dead pid/session (stale lease cleared, logged)
a genuine second live writer still refuses
unit tests for re-mint, stale-clear, and live-writer refusal paths

release_decision.reason: Integration status is partial — 14/21 lanes cancelled without authorized scope drops and g1-unit-suite holds a recorded FAIL receipt; not release-ready.

self_note: Dominated by process defects, not product ones: the landed product diff (CandidateTicket validation, stability slot handling, haptic gate fixes, grammar corpus) looks coherent at 5848 LOC, but the machinery burned ~9 a-ticket attempts and 4 boss waiver round-trips on two uninstrumented failure modes (missing env prereqs, out-of-scope baseline gate reds) plus verbatim-retry dispatch. No gap-ledger or overwatch summary existed for this run (overwatch/ and evidence/ dirs absent) — observations.jsonl was the richest defect source. a-stability landed with a FAIL gate receipt; the a-haptic commit e61452f appears to have repaired the same 6 upstream-drift tests on the integration tip, so those failures are closed in canon at 5e1d5ec.
